scenario_1_kill9.break: Disable WAL (journal_mode=DELETE) — child writes without WAL, SIGKILL mid-burst

scenario_1_kill9.restore: Re-enable WAL in child script (useWal=true) to restore green

scenario_2_diskfull.encoding: it.skip '[NC] negative control: without max_page_count, write succeeds (E_IO guard removed)' — asserts caught===null

scenario_3_overflow.break: Set maxSize=Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER — no overflow guard fires
scenario_3_overflow.encoding: it.skip '[NC] negative control: without overflow guard (maxSize=MAX), all writes succeed' — asserts rejections.length===0

pre_existing_flake.test: batch of 10 items with 1 byte-duplicate returns 9 ok + 1 E_DEDUP with existing_uid
pre_existing_flake.cause: fastembed warmup timeout (30000ms limit) under concurrent test load. Not caused by HF-1 changes. Appeared on 1 of 5 gate runs.
pre_existing_flake.evidence: Test is in write.spec.ts (unmodified by S1). The chaos specs (3 new files) never failed across all runs.

notes: Scenario 1: child worker spawned as .cjs (avoids ESM module resolution in tmpdir), uses project-resolved require() paths for better-sqlite3 + sqlite-vec
Scenario 2: max_page_count set to currentPageCount+2 (≈8KB headroom); 100 rows×4KB each forces SQLITE_FULL → wrapDbError maps to E_IO
Scenario 3: maxSize=5, slow anchor holds queue; flood of 15 items causes >5 queue rejections with E_BUSY shape (retryable:true, retry_after_ms:250)
All chaos stores use OS tmpdir (mkdtemp), NOT ~/.memory
Cleanup: afterEach removes tmpdir + calls _resetAllLeasesForTest() + WriteQueue.clearInstances()

ADR status flip + BACKLOG sweep + closeout

blockers.note: os-unit generator runs the serve_mode:proxy memory-server as direct-stdio (no port listener) → launchd daemon unreachable. HF-5 writer-count forensics must distinguish the per-session soxe-serve process from the launchd daemon by owner (session vs os-unit) and confirm only one holds the writer lease. Fix is spec-governed (docs/spec/service-lifecycle.md §9).

discovered.note: CRITICAL: esbuild CJS bundle broke import.meta.url → embedding-provider __dirname resolution threw at init → memory-server launchd daemon crash-looped. Fixed in tools/bundle-extension.cjs (import.meta.url shim). Commit e87369e.
CRITICAL: memory_write auto-chunk deadlocked the serial WriteQueue via nested enqueue (any content >chunk_size*4 chars hung forever). Fixed to write chunks directly on writeDb. Commit a4023c3.
memory test-suite stabilization (corrupted auto-chunk test + missing testTimeout; obsolete hash-backend tests; recluster 0-cluster lens marker). Commit a4023c3.
